tasks.short: Assess financial exposures and recommend which risks need attention.

steps.what: Read {ERP} exposures, {BANK} balances and treasury-system {OTHER} positions.
Reconcile exposures and calculate concentrations in {SPREADSHEET}.
Assess vulnerabilities using concentration analysis, risk metrics and business plans in {DOCS}.
Write the risk report and proposed mitigations in {DOCS}.

loop.input: Approved analytical findings, calculated tables and report template.
loop.output: Draft risk report with source references.
loop.check: Check every figure against calculated tables; specialist checks conclusions and wording.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; unresolved claims return to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables are deterministic, but the narrative must express case-specific reasoning.

steps.what: Discuss recommendations and agree priorities with the risk owner.
Approve risk actions and record owners in {PROJECT}.

tasks.design: Scheduled integrations on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reconcile {ERP}, {BANK} and treasury-system {OTHER} exposures, then publish concentrations and exceptions in {BI}. A bounded drafting loop prepares a sourced report in {DOCS}; the specialist reviews it, and the risk owner approves actions through {WORKFLOW} into {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source identifiers and reporting dates differ. Business vulnerability cannot be reduced to concentration thresholds.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes connectors, reconciliation checks and report templates cheaper to build. Existing arithmetic and risk methods remain the foundation.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete exposures, correlated shocks and uncertain business responses still require judgement. Data permissions and reconciliation remain substantial work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a plausible threat that historical metrics miss and negotiate a mitigation the business can execute.

ambition.what: Weekly prioritisation of customer and counterparty concentration risks.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts toward investigating concentrations and testing mitigations with business owners. Authority to change limits or accept risk stays with the existing risk owner.

reach.learn: Learn receivables ageing, collateral quality and customer limit escalation.

reach.task: Assess forecast sensitivity to customer losses.
reach.learn: Learn how revenue concentration affects cash and earnings forecasts.

evidence.claim: Exposure aggregation, concentration arithmetic and threshold checks can use deterministic code.
Moody's Credit Memo drafts from financial spreads and deal documents; this supports financial narrative drafting, not autonomous risk acceptance.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported statement tie-out work falling from eight to two hours; this is evidence for checking support, not a risk-analysis savings estimate.

assumptions: The baseline is a mid-size company managing corporate credit, liquidity and market exposures.
Time shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates, not measured customer results.
The build reuses approved risk methods and includes one reporting cycle in rollout.
Access work includes privacy review and employee consultation where national rules require it.
GDPR applies where personal data is processed; EU AI Act obligations depend on the actual AI use.
unknowns: Which exposure sources, identifiers and approved risk limits exist?
Are customer, bank and treasury exports complete and accessible?
Who can approve risk actions and changes to risk appetite?
Does the assessment include natural persons or employee monitoring?
research_questions: Which reconciliation controls detect omitted or duplicated exposures?
Which concentration measures predict useful interventions in this sector?
Which report sections need narrative generation rather than fixed templates?
new_work: Review reconciliation exceptions and sourced report drafts.
Maintain exposure mappings, thresholds and report templates.
Investigate stale data and failed connector runs.
Check that published conclusions still match the approved analytical findings.

tasks.short: Assess how new legislation changes financial risk and required controls.

steps.what: Read official legislative notices in {GOV_PORTAL} and save relevant versions in {DOCS}.
Read legislation in {DOCS} and extract obligations, scope and commencement provisions.

loop.input: Versioned official legal text, amendments and commencement provisions.
loop.output: Candidate obligations with article citations, scope and dates.
loop.check: Verify citations and quotations; reviewer checks exceptions, amendments and effective dates.
loop.stop: Process one source pack with one correction pass; conflicting provisions go to legal counsel.
loop.why_not_simpler: Obligations and exceptions are expressed in varied legal prose and cross-references.

steps.what: Map obligations to activities, exposures and existing controls in {SPREADSHEET}.

loop.input: Reviewed obligations and descriptions of activities, exposures and controls.
loop.output: Candidate obligation-to-activity links with reasons and source references.
loop.check: Require valid register IDs; specialist accepts or rejects each material applicability link.
loop.stop: One mapping pass per obligation and one revision; ambiguous applicability goes to legal counsel.
loop.why_not_simpler: Business descriptions rarely share exact terminology with legal scope clauses.

steps.what: Resolve applicability and financial consequences with legal counsel.
Prepare an impact brief and proposed control changes in {DOCS}.
Approve control changes and assign implementation work in {PROJECT}.

tasks.design: A scheduled collector versions official {GOV_PORTAL} notices in {DOCS}; bounded extraction and mapping loops propose cited obligations in a {WORKFLOW} register. Reviewed records generate the impact brief, while legal interpretation and approval of control changes stay with people before work enters {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Legal changes combine prose, amendments and jurisdiction-specific scope. Activity and control descriptions are often maintained separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded text extraction can prepare cited records, while deterministic versioning, deadlines and document generation handle the surrounding work.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, transitional provisions and financial consequences can remain uncertain. Legal counsel must resolve material ambiguity.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a legally plausible reading from a defensible interpretation for the company's actual activities.

ambition.what: Monthly legislative exposure clinic for treasury and credit teams.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends more time discussing implications with control owners and legal counsel. Legal interpretation and control approval rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Track regulatory obligations and control remediation.
reach.learn: Learn obligation ownership, evidence retention and implementation assurance.

reach.task: Assess regulatory effects on financing and hedging.
reach.learn: Learn financing covenants, permitted instruments and treasury operating constraints.

evidence.claim: Version comparison, obligation records, deadline reminders and structured impact briefs can use deterministic technology.
Cited legal extraction and applicability mapping are proposed bounded loops; the digest contains no direct deployment case for this task.
GDPR and EU AI Act requirements must be assessed for the actual processing and AI use; national employment and consultation rules vary.

assumptions: Official sources are available for a defined set of jurisdictions and activities.
The scope is impact assessment, with legal counsel available for material ambiguity.
The brief uses reviewed structured findings, so its generation needs no additional model loop.
Build ranges include access review and employee consultation where national rules require it.
Time and effort estimates are indicative; legislative monitoring savings are not established by the digest.
unknowns: Which jurisdictions, legal entities and regulated activities are in scope?
Which official sources offer reliable feeds or downloadable notices?
Is there a current activity register and control register?
Who signs off legal interpretations and implementation deadlines?
research_questions: How reliably can extraction capture exemptions and commencement provisions?
What historical legal changes should form the evaluation set?
Which sources distinguish enacted law from proposals and guidance?
new_work: Review extracted obligations and proposed applicability links.
Maintain source coverage and jurisdiction mappings.
Resolve conflicting amendments and missing commencement provisions.
Update evaluation examples when legal drafting or source formats change.

tasks.short: Quantify financial risk with statistical models and validate the results.

steps.what: Extract exposures from {ERP} and market history from market-data software {OTHER}.
Clean, align and reconcile model inputs in {SPREADSHEET}.
Choose model assumptions and scenarios in statistical software {OTHER}.
Run estimates, sensitivities and backtests in statistical software {OTHER}.
Evaluate model limitations and validation results against the model specification in {DOCS}.
Review material changes and approve risk metrics for publication in {BI}.

tasks.design: Integrations build a reconciled risk dataset on the {DATA_PLATFORM}, while configured statistical software {OTHER} runs versioned estimates, scenarios and backtests. Validation exceptions and model reviews pass through {WORKFLOW}, and approved risk metrics feed {BI} and downstream risk assessments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data preparation and run settings were handled separately. Automating calculation did not settle model suitability or validation.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding speeds data adapters and reproducible run configuration. Established statistical libraries and software already perform the numerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Sparse history, changing correlations, tail events and model instability remain difficult. Independent review capacity can limit rollout.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a precise estimate is misleading and choose scenarios that expose the model's blind spots.

ambition.what: Weekly selection of liquidity stress scenarios for the cash forecast.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends less time preparing runs and more time challenging assumptions with treasury and model reviewers. Authority to approve material model changes remains unchanged.

reach.task: Validate predictive models and monitor drift.
reach.learn: Learn time-series validation, calibration and reproducible model evaluation.
Learn liquidity horizons, cash-flow dependencies and funding constraints.

evidence.claim: Numerical risk estimates, sensitivities and backtests can run in configured statistical software without a language-model loop.
Automating an approved analytical method is different from validating whether that method remains suitable.
The digest provides no documented statistical-risk deployment supporting a task-specific savings figure.

assumptions: The initial build automates an existing approved method rather than developing a new risk model.
Current statistical software supports saved scripts or repeatable batch runs.
Material method changes receive independent review; routine reruns follow approved validation rules.
Build ranges include historical replay, parallel runs and access review.
Employee consultation is included where national rules require it.
GDPR and EU AI Act applicability is assessed if models use personal data or affect natural persons.
unknowns: Which statistical software and execution interfaces are available?
Are market-data licences compatible with automated processing and internal redistribution?
How much reliable history and realised-outcome data exists?
Which model changes require independent approval?
Are current calculations reproducible from versioned inputs?
research_questions: Which benchmark calculations expose numerical and data-alignment errors?
What validation thresholds distinguish a failed run from a model weakness?
Can current software schedule runs without replacing the analytical engine?
new_work: Maintain data-quality rules and investigate rejected datasets.
Review validation exceptions and changing model behaviour.
Version assumptions, scenarios and numerical dependencies.
Maintain reproducibility records and market-data entitlements.

tasks.short: Discuss trading strategies and positions with traders to identify and communicate risk.

steps.what: Read treasury-system {OTHER} positions and risk metrics before the discussion.
Prepare sensitivities and discussion points in {SPREADSHEET} and {DOCS}.
Discuss strategy intent, market conditions and risk trade-offs with the trader.
Write the discussion record and circulate proposed actions through {EMAIL}.

loop.input: Specialist's written notes, position snapshot and proposed actions.
loop.output: Draft discussion record with owners, unresolved questions and proposed actions.
loop.check: Specialist checks attribution, figures and agreement status before internal circulation.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unclear agreement remains explicitly unresolved.
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text notes need interpretation without inventing agreement or losing qualifications.

steps.what: Approve escalated risk actions and record the decision in treasury-system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: A deterministic briefing generator combines treasury-system {OTHER} positions, approved {BI} risk metrics and scenario calculations in {DOCS}. The discussion remains human; a bounded loop drafts its record from written notes, and reviewed actions enter {WORKFLOW} for any required approval before recording in {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Positions change quickly, and preparation draws from several sources. The central work depends on understanding intent and challenging a colleague.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable position integrations and scenario templates reduce preparation. A bounded drafting loop can organise written notes without assuming that a decision was approved.
tasks.still_hard: Live market uncertainty, conflicting incentives and tacit strategy knowledge remain human work. Position freshness and escalation discipline matter.
tasks.human_edge: Ask the difficult follow-up question, detect hidden assumptions and challenge a strategy while preserving trust.

ambition.what: Pre-trade hedge scenario clinic for treasury.

tasks.altitude: The week contains more prepared discussions about hedge alternatives and fewer briefing chores. Trading, limit and risk-acceptance rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Select hedging strategies for currency and interest-rate exposure.
reach.learn: Learn hedge objectives, instrument mechanics and liquidity effects.

reach.task: Compare strategy sensitivities under market scenarios.
reach.learn: Learn valuation assumptions, scenario interpretation and strategy constraints.

evidence.claim: Position briefings and scenario tables can use deterministic integration and report generation.
Moody's Credit Memo demonstrates drafting from financial inputs; it does not establish reliable trader-dialogue interpretation.
Strategy challenge, negotiation and risk acceptance remain matters for accountable people.

assumptions: This task applies to companies with trading or treasury dealing activity; many mid-size companies have no trader role.
The baseline is a scheduled strategy discussion; urgent live-market exchanges may have different time shares.
The approval step applies when a discussion produces an action requiring escalation.
The solution uses written notes and does not require meeting recording.
Build ranges assume reuse of approved risk metrics and include access review and consultation where national rules require it.
GDPR applies to identifiable discussion records; EU AI Act applicability depends on the actual AI use.
unknowns: Does the company have traders, treasury dealers or neither?
How current are position records at the time of discussion?
Which instruments and strategies are permitted?
Which actions require approval and who holds that authority?
What record-retention and employee consultation requirements apply?
research_questions: Which briefing scenarios help traders change a proposed strategy?
What freshness threshold makes a position snapshot usable?
Can note drafting reliably distinguish proposals, objections and approved decisions?
new_work: Maintain scenario templates and position freshness checks.
Resolve unclear ownership and disputed agreement.
Monitor action-record failures and escalation exceptions.

role.altitude: The role shifts toward interpreting vulnerabilities, challenging models and discussing mitigations. Existing authorities retain decisions on risk appetite, material model changes and trading actions.
reach: Credit analysts: connect concentration monitoring to customer limit reviews.
Treasurers: connect risk scenarios to funding and hedge decisions.
Compliance officers: connect legal impact findings to control implementation.
Data scientists: strengthen validation and model monitoring.
skills_to_grow: Source-grounded review of generated financial narratives.
Legal applicability assessment with legal counsel.
Constructive challenge and communication of uncertainty.
role.ambitious_version: Provide a shared financial-risk service that connects weekly concentration reviews, liquidity stress scenarios and pre-trade hedge discussions using the same governed exposure data.
